title: Scenario endpoint + property-screen scenario surface: internal flag-gated GET /api/v1/properties/{bbl}/scenario serving the M5-T001 draft coverage-aware scenario verbatim, plus the flag-gated property-screen scenario panel with honest no-scenario states, provenance, and needs_review disclaimer (R5 pilot; D-021)
objective: Expose the merged M5-T001 deterministic scenario foundation end to end for the R5 single-lot low-rise family-residential pilot. Backend: add GET /api/v1/properties/{bbl}/scenario mirroring the M4-T005 rule-evaluation endpoint pattern exactly - internal/dev only, feature-flag gated OFF by default (new INTERNAL_SCENARIO_ENABLED config token; absent/unknown -> generic 404 indistinguishable from unmounted, include_in_schema=False), bbl path param only (never a request body or browser-supplied profile), server-side rebuild of the canonical property profile via the trusted injected PLUTO fetcher + spatial substrate provider, server-side rule evaluation via evaluate_property, then app.scenario.builder.build_scenario consumed READ-ONLY with NO assumptions, validated with validate_scenario_document BEFORE emit (closes FH-M5T001-S1) plus a bounded-depth guard on the assembled document (closes FH-M5T001-S2); a no_scenario/unsupported/professional-review outcome is a NORMAL 200 scenario document, never an error; typed error mapping identical to the rule-evaluation route; correlation id on every response; no traceback/path/secret leakage. Frontend: add a flag-gated scenario surface to the existing Property screen mirroring the rule-evaluation panel pattern (lib/scenario.ts + components/scenario/*), rendering the draft zoning-floor-area cap VERBATIM with its draft-cap label, rule citations/provenance, coverage status (never verified), needs_review + not_verified_disclaimer, and honest typed no-scenario states (unsupported, missing constraint, spatial uncertainty, conflict, malformed) - flag off -> nothing renders and no fetch fires. Deterministic code only; no AI; no recomputation of the cap anywhere (surfaced value == canonical trace value); scenario/profile/rules modules and canonical contracts consumed READ-ONLY and unchanged. Tests: API acceptance pack (flag off/on, happy path, each no-scenario family, malformed input, validate-before-emit, depth bound, error mapping) + web vitest component tests + Playwright e2e vs the recorded-official-fixture API (scenario.spec.ts + scenario-flag-off.spec.ts patterned on rule-evaluation specs).
business_reason: D-021 (owner 2026-08-19): resume building the actual product; single next dependency-ready end-to-end unit a future user can calculate and view - turns the merged but invisible M5-T001 scenario foundation into a working, honest, provenance-preserving scenario view for the R5 pilot while preserving the five-borough architecture and staged rule expansion. M5 engineering vs merged draft/needs_review M4 artifacts remains authorized (owner 2026-07-21/22); final acceptance of the draft-rule chain still owes genuine G6 legal approval - not weakened by this task.

acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 API flag off (default): INTERNAL_SCENARIO_ENABLED absent/empty/unknown -> GET /api/v1/properties/{bbl}/scenario returns the generic 404 {"detail":"Not Found"} byte-indistinguishable from an unmounted path, no correlation id, absent from OpenAPI; flag-off is the DEFAULT deployment posture.

AS-2 API happy path (R5 pilot): flag on + recorded R5 fixture (confident district, conditional rule_evaluation with finite max_residential_floor_area_sq_ft) -> 200 scenario document whose surfaced cap == the canonical trace value VERBATIM (asserted against the fixture trace, never recomputed), draft-zoning-floor-area-cap label, citations + provenance, coverage conditional (never verified), needs_review + not_verified_disclaimer, X-Correlation-ID present.

AS-3 API honest no-scenario families: unsupported district, missing critical constraint, spatial uncertainty / professional_review_required, data/rule conflict, malformed or non-finite inputs -> each yields a NORMAL 200 scenario document with the typed no_scenario/unsupported outcome and a visible reason; never a 500, never an invented or negative/NaN/inf value.

AS-4 validate-before-emit + depth bound (FH-M5T001-S1/S2): the endpoint always calls validate_scenario_document before send - a document failing validation becomes typed internal_contract_error 500 with no internals; an adversarially deep-nested provenance sub-object hits a bounded-depth guard and returns a typed failure, never RecursionError/stack exhaustion.

AS-5 API error-mapping parity: malformed BBL -> 422 typed validation_error; upstream connector failures -> the same single-sourced status map as the rule-evaluation route; dataset no_match -> 404 machine-state body with source/dataset ids; unexpected exception -> documented generic 500; no traceback, path, secret, or internal string in any response.

AS-6 no injection surface: the route accepts ONLY the bbl path parameter - no request body, no query-supplied profile/rule-evaluation/assumptions; POST returns 405; the browser can never supply the facts a scenario rests on.

AS-7 web flag off: with the scenario surface flag off, the property screen renders zero scenario UI and fires zero scenario fetches (spec patterned on rule-evaluation-flag-off.spec.ts); the property profile remains fully usable.

AS-8 web happy path: flag on -> the property screen shows the draft cap VERBATIM (value equals the fixture's canonical trace value), draft-cap label, provenance disclosure, coverage badge never 'verified', needs_review + not_verified_disclaimer; every 200 body is runtime-validated against the generated scenario types before render, with validation failure as a distinct honest state.

AS-9 web honest failure states: each no-scenario family renders its typed honest state with the backend-produced reason (no invented numbers, no up-labeling); feature_unavailable (flag-off server 404) shows the benign 'not available in this environment' note and never blocks the profile; API faults render the recoverable failure state; outcome announcements/a11y consistent with the existing property-screen patterns.

AS-10 regression + determinism: full repository CI green; profile/spatial/rules/scenario modules, canonical contracts, and all unrelated tests byte-unchanged; identical input -> byte-identical 200 response body (deterministic ordering preserved from the builder).
risks: HARD: consume app/scenario, app/rules, app/profile READ-ONLY; the surfaced cap is the canonical trace value verbatim - never recomputed, never relabeled (backend or frontend).
HARD: endpoint OFF by default behind an explicit-true-token flag; only the bbl path parameter crosses the trust boundary; no request body ever.
Fail closed: validate_scenario_document + bounded-depth guard before every emit (closes FH-M5T001-S1/S2); no-scenario outcomes are honest 200 documents, never errors, never silence.
Never emit or render 'verified'; needs_review + not_verified_disclaimer carried end-to-end; frontend classifies presentation only, never computes legal values (PRODUCT_FLOW_AND_AI_BOUNDARIES).
